title: Three-Dimensional Shapes
introduction: Identify solids by their flat and curved surfaces, edges and vertices.
definition: Identify solids by their flat and curved surfaces, edges and vertices.

examples.question: How many flat faces does a cube have?
steps: A cube has six square faces.

examples.question: How many vertices does a cuboid have?
steps: Four top and four bottom vertices.

exercises.question: How many flat faces does a cube have?
exercises.solution: A cube has six square faces. Answer: 6

exercises.question: How many vertices does a cuboid have?
exercises.solution: Four top and four bottom vertices. Answer: 8

exercises.question: Which solid has only a curved surface?
exercises.solution: A sphere has no flat faces. Answer: sphere
